Class VectorTest

java.lang.Object
primitives.VectorTest
class VectorTest extends Object
Unit tests for class Vector. The tests verify:
  • Vector.add(Vector)
  • Point.subtract(Point)
  • Vector.scale(double)
  • Vector.dotProduct(Vector)
  • Vector.crossProduct(Vector)
  • Vector.lengthSquared()
  • Vector.length()
  • Vector.normalize()
  • Point.distanceSquared(Point)
  • Point.distance(Point)
Tests follow the methodology of Equivalence Partitions (EP) and Boundary Values (BVA).

  • Method Details

    • testConstructors

      @Test void testConstructors()
      test method for Vector(double, double, double) and for Vector(Double3). Verifies that a vector is constructed correctly and that constructing a zero vector throws an exception.

    • testAdd

      @Test void testAdd()
      Test method for Vector.add(Vector). Verifies vector addition and zero-vector boundary case.

    • testSubtract

      @Test void testSubtract()
      Test method for Point.subtract(Point). Verifies vector subtraction and zero-vector boundary case.

    • testScale

      @Test void testScale()
      Test method for Vector.scale(double). Verifies correct scaling and zero-scalar boundary case.

    • testDotProduct

      @Test void testDotProduct()
      Test method for Vector.dotProduct(Vector). Verifies orthogonality and correct scalar product.

    • testCrossProduct

      @Test void testCrossProduct()
      Test method for Vector.crossProduct(Vector). Verifies orthogonality, length relation and parallel-vector boundary case.

    • testLengthSquared

      @Test void testLengthSquared()
      Test method for Vector.lengthSquared(). Verifies squared length computation.

    • testLength

      @Test void testLength()
      Test method for Vector.length(). Verifies vector length computation.

    • testNormalize

      @Test void testNormalize()
      Test method for Vector.normalize(). Verifies that normalized vector has unit length and same direction.

    • testDistanceSquared

      @Test void testDistanceSquared()
      Test method for Point.distanceSquared(Point). Verifies squared distance computation inherited from Point.

    • testDistance

      @Test void testDistance()
      Test method for Point.distance(Point). Verifies distance computation inherited from Point.
